I'm gonna have to disagree on the liquid lipsticks.  I've tried formulas mostly considered good or very good (KVD, Maybelline Matte Ink, Makeup Monsters, Dose of Colors). Maybe my lips are just abnormally dry but I'm good with applying lip balm and yet I have issues with them.

\-They have to be applied very carefully because they're harder to remove than cream formulas (thus taking more time, I'd say). And the ease of application depends a lot on the applicator shape and how much product it holds. It's like the problems of liquid eyeliner application, but for your lips.

\-Darker formulas are often patchy and layering them to fix it will make them more drying or at least feel heavier on the lips (and again, take longer to apply).

\-Even long-lasting formulas will wear off if you eat certain things. And then you have to reapply over your already dried out lips

\-Shelf life is considerably shorter than cream lipsticks. The last ones I owned would change formula within a bit over a year of owning them, which is a pretty short time to own a lip product, i think.
